product_context.problem_statement: Recruiters spend too much time triaging high-volume applications and may apply criteria inconsistently.
product_context.value_hypothesis: Decision support can shorten qualified-candidate review time without reducing access or recruiter accountability.
product_context.user_journey_moment: After application completeness check and before recruiter shortlist review
product_context.fallback_experience: Recruiters use the standard chronological review queue when the assistant is unavailable or paused.

system_profile.purpose: Screen applications and recommend a shortlist for an entry-level tutoring role.
system_profile.decision_impact: The recommendation influences access to employment but does not make the final hiring decision.
system_profile.deployment_context: A private employer uses a vendor-hosted screening workflow for remote applicants.

system_boundary.model: ranking model and deterministic eligibility rules
system_boundary.application: candidate portal and recruiter review dashboard

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: Employment access affects income and dignity. Screening can operate at high scale, reproduce protected-group disparities, and hide errors from applicants, so meaningful review and appeal are essential.

vietnam.rationale: The exact function and market facts must be checked against the AI Law, implementing decree, and current high-risk list before deployment.

eu.rationale: Employment-related AI is an Annex III high-risk area, while the applicable obligation date and provider/deployer role still require current legal review.

legal_classification.other_markets: United States employment discrimination rules require separate counsel review.

product_metrics.success_kpi: Median time from complete application to first qualified recruiter review is at most two business days.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Qualified-candidate recall gap between monitored groups remains at or below five percentage points.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Automatic rejection count remains exactly zero in every production reporting period.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Monthly and before any material change to data criteria vendor model workflow or target market.

release_blockers: GAP-01: Vietnam classification review not yet signed
GAP-02: EU launch evidence not yet independently verified
release_decision.next_review_trigger: Review on any threshold breach incident vendor change new target market or 2026-10-31 whichever comes first.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Use is limited to recommendations; automatic rejection is disabled, appeal is available, and deployment stops if disparity or override thresholds are breached.
